'''Ryloth''' was a beverage served in the [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It shared its name with [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]],<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Twi'lek/Legends]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="FaD">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

The drink was served in [[Color/Legends|purple]] bottles with a label showing an idyllic Ryloth landscape at night, lit up by one of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Moon/Legends|moons]], with the name of the beverage printed in white [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters at the bottom. [[Ryloth (poster)/Legends|Advertisements]] featuring the same motif as the label were put up to promote the drink. A giant version appeared as a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] at [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]], although it was mirror-inverted and faded. A complete and un-mirrored poster appeared in the Moshi Bar.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />

When [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] visited Moshi Bar seeking information on [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], a bottle of Ryloth was sitting on a table shared by a [[Unidentified Patrolian (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Patrolian]] and an [[Unidentified Ithorian (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Ithorian]]. Another bottle was sitting on the bar counter.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />
